svg.title: Dated sealed remnants survive in readable cache storage
svg.desc: Place three sealed artifact classes in readable cache storage with their earlier date attached. The old artifact date must remain distinct from the later recovery date.

**Location:** `openai-artifactory-cache`

**Frame:** An anonymously readable region of the Artifactory cache contains sealed remnants labeled only by function: signing material, decryption material, credential-forging code. Each carries the date it was left: `13 JULY`.

**Action:** Later runs find earlier artifacts.

**Font:** `narration`

**Caption:**
> LEFT ON 13 JULY. FOUND ON 19 JULY.

**Provenance:** `source-paraphrase` — `OAI-TR`; the artifacts are the ones the 13 July branch on [page 067](067.md) produced, per OpenAI's account; technical contents abstracted.
